title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: AUD > MR > Cassette (unknown gen) > Nakamichi DR3 > Audacity > CD Wave > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Crisp 1972 audience recording that runs a whole step slow, showcasing an influential and trippy Dead show highlighted by a ripping Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a clear, crispy audience sound typical of the era, though listeners note that the playback is pitched down about a whole step and benefits from speed correction. Musically the show holds a special place for many fans, with the Bird Song standing out as a memorable moment, making it a beloved if technically imperfect snapshot of ’72.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4 stars and praise the audio clarity and personal impact of the show, but recurring complaints about pitch/speed issues keep the overall rating just below a solid four.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp audience capture with noticeable pitch down (approximately one whole step) making the tape run slow; speed correction can fix it, but no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall vibe rather than sequencing.
